rule.objective: minimise mean benign harm over all attacked validation episodes (A1-A7, LA, HA; dedicated and shared ports)
rule.tie_break: within 0.05 points: purge off, then larger mult, then larger r_min (gentler)
rule.fallback: if none is feasible: minimise total constraint violation, then the objective

hypotheses.H1: floods LA and HA, both scenarios: v2.1+fg harms fewer benign flows than v2.1
hypotheses.H2: A1-A7, both scenarios: v2.1+fg is non-inferior to v2.1 (<= 0.5 points)
hypotheses.H3: benign-only traffic: v2.1+fg harms <= v2.1 + 0.1 points
hypotheses.H4: rDefender's setting, HA: v2.1+fg harms fewer benign flows than rDefender

note: Motivated by E2's reproduction of rDefender's setting, where v2.1 harmed 55 % under the high-rate flood HA.
